notes.title: PATCH 1.0.0.15 online today!
notes.content:
A new update is now available! Have fun with the Race Director Mode and the Weekly Challenges!

 Multiplayer Online: added Race Director Mode
 Added Weekly Challenges
 Minor fixes

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.13 is now available!
notes.content:
Riders, a new update is now available! Please check all the news in the list below:


 Increased top speed for all motorcycles
 Time Trial: rewards are now based on completed laps instead of completed valid laps only
 Time Trial: the quick leaderboard in pre-race menu now shows the best valid lap for each bike model 
 Reduced grip on grass and sand when “Off-Track Help” option is Off
 Missing exhaust on Ducati 1098R RM 2008 added 
 Headlights issue on Kawasaki ZX-10R 2004 fixed 
 Sparks issue on Kawasaki ZX-6R 2019 fixed
 Added support for add-ons
 Minor fixes

notes.title: SUPERBIKES 2000 DLC is now Available!
notes.content:
Ready for a new adventure with 5 new Superbikes? 
Ducati 1098R, Honda VTR1000 SP2, Yamaha YZF-R1, Kawasaki Ninja ZX-10R,  Honda CBR 1000RR Fireblade.
Find them all in the SUPERBIKES 2000 DLC! Find below all the contents you'll find in our latest DLC:


 DUCATI 1098R – Racing Modified (2008)
 HONDA VTR1000 SP2 (2006)
 YAMAHA YZF-R1 (2004)
 KAWASAKI NINJA ZX-10R (2004)
 HONDA CBR 1000RR FIREBLADE – Racing Modified (2008)
 10 EVENTS
 3 ACHIEVEMENTS


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1365150/RIDE_4__Superbikes_2000/

notes.title: KYALAMI Pack is now available
notes.content:
RIDE 4 is constantly moving forward.
Today we're happy to announce that the KYALAMI Pack is now available, adding the following content to the game:


 KYALAMI GRAND PRIX CIRCUIT
 10 EVENTS
 3 ACHIEVEMENTS


We're always hearing your feedback, so keep playing and tell us what you think about your experience!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.8 is now online
notes.content:
Riders, a new update is now avaliable with some improvements on tyres temperature system, anti-wheelie and more. Here's the list:



 Improved tyres temperature system 
 Improved Anti-Wheelie
 Some career thresholds have been revised
 Added support for add-ons (PS4-XONE)
 Minor fixes
 


https://ridevideogame.com/game-updates/new-patch-realesed-ps4-xone-steam-3/

notes.title: Ultimate 2020 DLC is now available
notes.content:
Hello riders!

As you may know, our post launch support for RIDE 4 is huge! We're adding content each month, both free and premium, aiming to make our beloved game always better.

Today it's time for the Ultimate 2020 DLC, a content pack that you'll love for sure. Please find all the new things in the list below, and remember to keep report to us your feedbacks and opinions.


 5 exclusive bikes: MV Agusta Superveloce 800 (2019), Triumph Daytona 765 Moto2 (2020), Yamaha YZF-R1M (2020), Ducati V4 S Naked - Racing Modified (2020), Energica Ego (2020)
 10 extra events.

notes.title: BONUS PACK 02
notes.content:
Hello Riders!

RIDE 4 is just at the beginning of his adventure, and we're continuing to add more and more content to the game. Today we're releasing our BONUS PACK 02 free DLC, that includes a bike that you'll love for sure, along with some new event.


 YZF-R1 – Endurance Modified (2014)
 5 Extra Events


See you on the track!

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.0.7
notes.content:
Hello Riders! A new update is finally here!
We're always monitoring what the community ask and report to us, and the results are specific patch aimed to improve your gameplay experience. See full detail below:


 Rims on RM and EM models can now be customized with colors and materials
 Improved TCS functioning
 Missing lights in night career events fixed
 Added support for add-ons
 Minor fixes


https://ridevideogame.com/game-updates/new-patch-realesed-ps4-xone-steam-2/

notes.title: NEW GAME UPDATE
notes.content: We're reading all your comments and are currently working on improving and fixing some aspects of the game. As a first step we're releasing a patch to make the game more tolerant out of track detection. Stay tuned for more updates.
